---
title: "Explore"
subtitle: "Features along the canal, ordered from Georgetown to Cumberland."
description-meta: "Filter and browse normalized access points, locks, aqueducts, campgrounds, and other features along the C&O Canal."
---

::: {.explore-table}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false

featureDocument = FileAttachment("data/public/json/features.json").json()
featureTypes = ["all", ...Array.from(new Set(featureDocument.features.map(d => d.feature_type))).sort()]
featureTypeLabel = value => value.replaceAll("_", " ").replace(/^./, letter => letter.toUpperCase())

viewof selectedType = Inputs.select(featureTypes, {
  label: "Feature type",
  value: "all",
  format: featureTypeLabel
})

visibleFeatures = featureDocument.features.filter(d => selectedType === "all" || d.feature_type === selectedType)

featureTable = {
  const table = Inputs.table(
    visibleFeatures.map(d => ({
      mile: d.mile_end == null ? d.mile : `${d.mile}–${d.mile_end}`,
      name: d.name,
      type: d.feature_type.replaceAll("_", " "),
      latitude: d.latitude,
      longitude: d.longitude
    })),
    {
      columns: ["mile", "name", "type", "latitude", "longitude"],
      header: {mile: "Mile", name: "Name", type: "Type", latitude: "Latitude", longitude: "Longitude"},
      rows: 20,
      sort: "mile"
    }
  );
  table.setAttribute("aria-label", "Canal features; scroll horizontally for coordinates");
  table.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
  return table;
}
```
:::

<noscript>
The interactive table requires JavaScript. Download the complete feature index as
[CSV](data/public/csv/features.csv) or [JSON](data/public/json/features.json).
</noscript>

Coordinates for access points come from the C&O Canal Association reference.
Coordinates for milepost-only locks, aqueducts, campgrounds, and recreation
features are derived from the canonical towpath geometry. They are suitable for
exploration and analysis, not turn-by-turn navigation.
